scripts.test:js: pnpm run build && node packages/sepal/test/mock-host.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/dom.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/url.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/text.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/routes.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/custom-router.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/bindings.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/head.test.js && node packages/sepal/test/icon.test.js && pnpm --filter tracker test
scripts.test:host: pnpm run build && cargo test --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml --features screenshot
scripts.test: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:js && pnpm run test:host && pnpm run test:template
scripts.dev: cargo build --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml && SEPAL_HOST=$PWD/crates/host/target/debug/calyx pnpm --filter counter watch
scripts.dev:tracker: cargo build --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml && SEPAL_HOST=$PWD/crates/host/target/debug/calyx pnpm --filter tracker exec vite build --watch
scripts.start: pnpm run build && cargo run --release --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml -- examples/counter/dist
scripts.start:icons: pnpm run build && cargo run --release --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml -- examples/icons/dist
scripts.screenshot: pnpm run build && cargo run --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml --features screenshot -- --screenshot screenshot.png examples/counter/dist
scripts.bundle: pnpm run build && cargo run --release --manifest-path crates/host/Cargo.toml -- --bundle examples/counter/dist
